title: InstantSearch component updating status inside unrelated InstantSearch component
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

Consider this scenario:

```
<Header>
   <InstantSearch id="1" {...relevantProps}>
       <SearchBox />
   </InstantSearch>
</Header>

<SearchPage>
   <InstantSearch id="2" {...relevantProps}>
       <SearchBox style={{ display: "none" }} />
       <Hits />
   </InstantSearch>
</SearchPage>
```

The issue is that inside SearchPage I want the loading state of the second (id: 2) instantsearch component. I do this with the useInstantSearch hook to retrieve the status. The peculiar thing is that whenever I click the SearchBox in the header (id: 1), the status of the second InstantSearch component reacts to this and updates the status object, setting it to "loading", then "stalled", then "idle".

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

Try above scenario.

### Live reproduction

n/a

### 💭 Expected behavior

I expect the status state to be seperate and not react to unrelated InstantSearch components.

### Package version

instantsearch.js@4.66.1, react-instantsearch@7.7.1

### Operating system

Windows 11

### Browser

Chrome 122.0.6261.131
